basics.name: Ada Lovelace
basics.label: Analyst and Writer
basics.summary: Mathematician who writes about what calculating engines could do beyond arithmetic. Interested in symbols, music and the patterns that connect them, and in explaining hard ideas plainly.

work.name: Analytical Engine Project
work.summary: Translated and annotated a paper on the engine, then extended it with notes three times its length.
highlights: Wrote the first published algorithm intended for a machine: computing Bernoulli numbers on the engine.
Described how the engine could act on symbols other than numbers, such as musical notes.
Corrected errors in the original paper and worked through each step of the method in a table.

work.name: Royal Society Reading Room
highlights: Kept up a long correspondence on calculus, probability and logic.
Studied mathematics with tutors and wrote up each lesson as a set of worked problems.

projects.name: Note G
projects.description: A step-by-step method for computing Bernoulli numbers on the Analytical Engine.

awards.title: Honorary Member
awards.summary: For the notes on the Analytical Engine.
